page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a decorative border above the heading and a large woodcut initial V. The left strip beyond the gutter belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. No margin notes. Signature "A 2" at the foot, catchword "tamen" at the right.

main_text.head: THESIS I.
main_text.p: Versamur adhuc in tractatione Nominis, variaque vocabuli Theologiæ significatione, à qua ipsa quoque rerum planior, & plenior explicatio pendet.
ה Theologia vel infusa, vel acquisita.

Fluit hæc distinctio ex diversis causis efficientibus. Illa enim ordinario studio, & subsidiis requisitis comparatur; adeòque ἐπίκτητος est; hæc extraordinariè, nulla prævia institutione, infusa, adeoque θεόδιδακτος[?] appellari potest. De illa Apostolus loquitur, 2.Tim.1.v.13. Teneto ὑποτύπωσιν[?] expressam formam saniorum sermonum, quos à me audivisti, &c. & cap.3.v.15. ἀπὸ βρέφους, a puero nõlti[?] sacras literas. De hac verò Petrus, ex Joële, Act: 2.v.17.18. Effundam de Spiritu meo in omnem carnem: & prophetabunt filii vestri, & filiæ vestræ, & juvenes vestri visiones videbunt &c. de hac quoque ipse Servator Matth.10.v.19. Cùm autem tradiderint vos, ne estote soliciti quomodo aut quid loquuturi sitis, dabitur enim vobis ea ipsa hora, quid loquamini.

Canon, de infusa: Theologia infusa, ratione Finis, vel Canonica est, vel exomologetica tantum. Differentia hæc diligenter est observanda. Ea enim Theologia, quæ Prophetis, Apostolis, Evangelistis est concessa atque communicata immediatè, non illorum tantùm usibus privatis, sed communi Ecclesiæ ædificationi debebat inservire: adeòque & Canonica est. Sed quæ Martyribus, cerdonibus sæpe illiteratis, data est, & cælitus infusa rerum divinarum notitia, tantùm Exomologetica est, singulariùm potissimùm bono speciali concessa. Etsi enim illi vel propterea, quòd adversarii subtilissimi, & acutissimi, τῇ ἀπαιδεύτῳ[?] sapientiæ, & Spiritui, quo loquuntur, Act.6.v.10. resistere non possunt, ad exemplum constantiæ nobis ponantur; Canonicam tamen

page.notes: The left strip beyond the gutter (partial words such as "S.S.", "ofef", "AO", "gnatis") is the edge of the neighbouring page and was left out. Handwritten pen marks (underline under "Canonica est, vel exomologetica tantum", small marks in the margin and at "ἀπαιδεύτῳ") are not printed and were left out. Doubtful readings: "nõlti" (possibly "nosti"), the Greek words "θεόδιδακτος", "ὑποτύπωσιν" and "ἀπαιδεύτῳ", each marked [?]. The initial V is part of the word "Versamur".
